__comment: Rudimentary room heater — rough stacked fieldstone back and cheeks, open front, logs and glowing coals (doc 199).
Tier 1 Hearthblock model from tools/hearthblock/art/tier1.mjs (doc 256); the opening faces local +Z.
The stone back reaches 1.68 blocks inside the 2x2x2 collision envelope.
RoomManager counts 1600 heat units once at the origin. Small sealed bedrooms stay comfortable through the seasons.
Named body/flame meshes and ten low voxel flame frames preserve installed lighting and animation.
Installed hearths emit warm, gently flickering light. Ghosts and packed items remain unlit.
The shared packed-furniture item and floor-placement behavior are unchanged.
description: A compact stone room heater with an open firebox. Warms a small enclosed bedroom; larger rooms may need more heat. Face the opening into the room.
placement_note: Place inside an enclosed room. R turns the opening to face inward.
